conventions.frame: every asset is plan-local (Saved/Mashup/plan_v3.json: x east, y north, metres) about origin_plan_m, already turned for Unreal: place at Unreal (X = y*100, Y = x*100) with NO rotation, Z = traced ground
conventions.collide: complex = complex-as-simple collision; none = visual only; hidden = invisible collider (hidden in game)
conventions.zone: plan polygon to clear of street props/trees ('props') and City Sample building instances ('buildings')
